summary: On paper the Rams have the edge (The Rams' defense ranks 17th in broken tackles per touch, 11.1% missed), while Washington's best counter is to keep everything in front (Washington's defense ranks 4th in explosive play rate, 7.5% allowed). Under center, Matthew Stafford ranks 15th of 30 in EPA per dropback and Jayden Daniels ranks 17th; x-factor: Puka Nacua gets 27% of the Rams' targets and 26% of its air yards, and Washington's pass defense ranks 20th. The model favors the Rams at 67%, mostly on rushing matchup (4.8 pts) and passing matchup (1.5 pts).
